outcome: Clinical and epidemiological characteristics of SARS-CoV-2 infection in newborns
cohort: 34 newborns with positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, born to SARS-CoV-2 seropositive mothers, at the 'Instituto Nacional Materno Perinatal' in Peru between June 1 and September 30, 2020
finding: Neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection was rare, and most infected infants were asymptomatic, with favorable clinical evolution during the study period.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery did not appear to be related to complications during hospital care.
